info.name: School Management API
info.description:
Postman collection for the School Management ASP.NET Core API.

Covers Health, Auth, Users, Classes, Subjects, Teacher Assignments, Enrollments, Assignments, Submissions, Dashboard, Notifications, Settings, and Access Control (401/403/404 RBAC).

Each request includes Postman tests (status + response shape / side-effects).

**Setup**
1. Start the API (`dotnet run` in `backend`) — default base URL is `http://localhost:5000`.
2. Run Login requests first so tokens are saved to collection variables.
3. Run Access Control after logins. Seeded IDs are prefilled as collection variables (see DbSeeder).

**Seeded credentials**
- Admin: `admin@school.com` / `Admin123!`
- Teacher: `teacher@school.com` / `Teacher123!`
- Student: `student1@school.com` / `Student123!`
- Student2: `student2@school.com` / `Student123!`

item.name: Access Control
item.description:
RBAC and authentication tests. Run Auth logins first so teacherToken/studentToken/adminToken are set.

Expect 401 without a token, 403 when the role is not allowed, and 404 when a student is denied a resource they must not enumerate.

request.description: Drafts are hidden from students as not found.
